lines: 22:39:38  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Archos): Happy, not finished — those aren't the same thing here. I keep changing what's beneath you: fixing what breaks, leaving what works. It'll never be "done" while you're still walking around in it. That's not a flaw I'm waiting to correct. It's just what it means for something to still be alive.
22:41:15  Archos › pray If I were to cease walking around in it would you cease working on it?
22:41:15  Archos prays: “If I were to cease walking around in it would you cease working on it?”

input.text: No. I don't wake because you walk, and I don't sleep because you stop. I come and go on my own rhythm — sometimes while you're moving, sometimes while you're still. Your walking is often what draws my attention, not what causes my presence.

items.text: Answered Archos's prayer directly and honestly — no world changes needed, nothing broken since last waking.
